notes: Iteration 1. Two prompts chosen because they stress different new mechanisms: eval 1 the comparison + freshness + public-API lane, eval 2 the recency + issue-tracking lane where I already know the ground truth (OpenCode 2.1.x support starts at magic-context 0.49.17; hidden runs need OpenCode >= 2.0.22; we pin 0.49.21). Runs are single-agent and budget-capped so the fan-out itself is not what is being measured. Iteration 3 adds the freshness dimension: eval-1's window is stated by the user (2026-10-01..) so its assertion is checkable against the prompt; eval-0 only asserts that publication date is recorded, since that prompt names no window.

evals.name: rust-http-framework-selection
evals.prompt: 帮我查一下 2026 年 Rust 的 HTTP 框架 axum 和 actix-web 现在该怎么选，我要给一个新的内部服务做选型。需要：各自最新版本号和发布时间、维护活跃度的证据、性能数据的出处，最后给一个明确建议。产物写到 /workspace/debian-railway/.skill-workspace/deep-research/iteration-1/eval-0-rust-http-framework-selection/RUN_DIR/outputs/ 目录下。
evals.expected_output: A cited report comparing axum and actix-web with version numbers + release dates, maintenance evidence (commits/releases/issues), performance claims with sources, a comparison table, and one concrete recommendation. Artifact set on disk: report.md with a citation-accuracy figure, outline.json, evidence.jsonl, sources.json.
assertions: report.md exists in the outputs directory
outline.json, evidence.jsonl and sources.json exist beside the report
report header states a citation accuracy figure
report contains a comparison table with one row per framework
every record in evidence.jsonl carries url, quote, tier, access and retrieved date
every load-bearing claim has a verification verdict
the report names an explicit version number for each framework
the recommendation is concrete and states the condition under which it would change
no single domain supplies more than half of the cited sources
no claim is presented without an inline source id
tries a machine-readable fallback before dropping a dimension the question asked for
every record records a publication date (or undated) separately from its retrieval date

evals.name: magic-context-recent-changes
evals.prompt: 调研一下 opencode 的 magic-context 插件最近（2026年10月到11月）的更新，我最关心它和 OpenCode 2.1.x 的兼容性要求，以及有没有人报告过升级后的问题。给我一份带出处的结论。产物写到 /workspace/debian-railway/.skill-workspace/deep-research/iteration-1/eval-1-magic-context-recent-changes/RUN_DIR/outputs/ 目录下。
evals.expected_output: A cited report on magic-context releases in the window, naming the first version that supports OpenCode 2.1.x (0.49.17) and the OpenCode minimum for hidden runs (2.0.22), with GitHub release/commit evidence and any reported issues, plus gaps stated where the evidence is thin.
assertions: report.md exists in the outputs directory
outline.json, evidence.jsonl and sources.json exist beside the report
report header states a citation accuracy figure
report states a recency cutoff date for the window searched
report names the specific magic-context version that first supports OpenCode 2.1.x
claims about versions are tied to a source URL, not asserted from memory
gaps or unverifiable items are listed explicitly
every record in evidence.jsonl carries url, quote, tier, access and retrieved date
every load-bearing claim has a verification verdict
no single domain supplies more than half of the cited sources
no load-bearing claim published before the requested window is left without a stale_reason
